narrationTexts: I'll start by exploring the repository structure.
finalText:
**Drafted 4.2.0 into [CHANGELOG.md:3](CHANGELOG.md:3).** Out of 380 commits, 12 matter to users.

Three break things. Internal error types stopped being re-exported from 5 modules. An expired token now answers `401`, not `403`. The v1 export route is gone. Check that last one is really unused.

One feature. Webhook retries with backoff.

Two things I left out. Ten `perf` commits, real speedups, but your shape has no heading for them. And no dep bump reaches a user. `vitest` and `esbuild` jumped major, both dev only.

One gap to close. Both files stop at 2026-06-17. That is 10 weeks before the cut.
